text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The New Year has arrived. Starting this 
year, our challenge in the Classic Class 
with Narita Taishin finally begins!
choice_data_list:
(She's usually the type to avoid getting 
involved, but—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're about to embark on a truly important 
year. Since we're here, let's celebrate 
the New Year together and fire ourselves 
up anew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, after decorating the 
Trainer's Office, I went to fetch Narita 
Taishin, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I saw them wandering off just before 
noon!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And it looks like she isn't back yet!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa!? C-Cheer up, Taishin's 
Trainerrrr!!" his

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Um, um—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait!! Maybe they're taking a nap over 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... I slept so well—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa!? H-Hold on... How long have 
you been standing there...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, how did you even know I was here!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, that guy... He's always ruining 
my naps in the first place, and now...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Decided. Next time I see him, I'm 
definitely kicking him.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......And? Need something?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking we could make a New Year's 
resolution together

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Pass.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems impossible to get through to 
her...! However, I can't give up here if I 
want to be her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to at least spend New Year's 
together, I suggested—
choice_data_list:
Let's snuggle under the kotatsu and play 
some racing games!
Why not just have our meeting as usual?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, how does it even end up like that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, still better than going on about 
oaths and whatnot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin's hobby was gaming, if I 
remember correctly. Having caught her 
interest, I wasted no time setting up a 
kotatsu in the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
How to use items... Put a bit more thought 
into your timing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...The cornering isn't bad. Maybe it's 
fine to switch to a machine focused on top 
speed?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Don't get all emotional over 
something like this!! I only said it 
'cause I was bored!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow or another, we were able to 
spend a fun New Year's together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No way, idiot. I came all the way here 
because I wanted to sleep alone.
choice_data_list: Do you come here to nap often?
Do you come here to nap often?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What's that got to do with you? Who cares 
what my hobbies are?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah, exactly. I love napping. 
While I'm asleep, I can forget all the 
annoying stuff."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Also, grew taller—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, a chilly wind blew with a 
whistle—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Tsk!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.
choice_data_list:
Could you at least come sleep in the 
Trainer's office?

Why not at least come sleep in the 
Trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Just for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I watched over Narita Taishin as 
she slept curled up like a kitten under a 
blanket on the Trainer's office sofa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Talk about training? ...Well, I guess 
that's fine, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer's office. Let's get going 
already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa. Uh, what's with these 
decorations?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you do all of this by yourself? 
Just to celebrate this 'New Year' thing?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Toast that mochi over there for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that stupid look off your face and 
hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Holding a meeting in this atmosphere 
is completely impossible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin had finally given in, and 
we spent an enjoyable New Year's together.
